newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet prices dip, but diffs near steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet prices dip, but diffs near steady.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices slipped lower Thursday, tracking the drop on the NYMEX, though little change in the differentials was noted.
On the NYMEX, July heating oil fell 0.97 cent to end at 52.02 cents a gallon and August heating oil dropped 0.95 cent to settle at 52.22 cents a gallon.
Activity on the U.S. Gulf remained thin, with players putting the prompt 54-grade jet fuel between even to 0.25 cent over the August futures, according to traders.
Prompt New York Harbor 54-grade barrels were talked on either side of 1.75 cent over the July futures, slightly firmer than the previous day.
